assessedPlan.name: Arcloom Sustained Reconciliation Proof
assessedPlan.goal: Make Plan feedback loops runnable and safe to evolve by providing a reference Host, a deterministic local integration environment, repeated-cycle convergence verification, and real GitHub Plan evidence.
acceptanceConditions: A repository-owned reference Host accepts explicit Plan Request triggers and routes target-specific semantic Results without taking ownership of Reconciliation, scheduling, or external mutation decisions.
A deterministic local environment exercises the Plan Feedback Loop without credentials, external services, wall-clock sleeps, or manual state changes.
A multi-cycle integration test proves that fresh Observations, Result Destination delivery, and externally applied Task progress converge one Plan to Complete.
The same public contracts complete one real GitHub Plan Attempt and at least two later Attempts after real external state changes.
The resulting commands, tests, and evidence provide the development environment required for evidence-driven remodelling and refactoring in Milestone #3.
tasks: Run one end-to-end Plan Attempt for this Milestone.
Run repeated Attempts after real GitHub state changes and record feedback.
Drive this Plan's Tasks to completion and obtain a Complete assessment.
Remove Arcloom metadata dependency from GitHub Plan representation and observation.
Provide a deterministic local Plan feedback-loop test environment.
Prove multi-cycle Plan convergence with a deterministic integration test.
Provide a reference Host composition for Plan feedback loops.
Bind real GitHub Plan observations into the reference Host.
Bind Codex Plan Control into the reference Host through the Go SDK.
Provide Request-source and Result-Destination routing in the reference Host.
